title: Nice Set But
text: Nice Set But. I do love the color (they go amazing with my red dishes) and they are made well BUT they retain water spots and the forks are so skinny. My Dad who is a larger man actually asked for a bigger fork. It is a really good starter set and overall I am pleased, but not sure I would buy again or gift them.
